title: Aoyagi Toya — A Love Song Dedicated To You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: A Love Song Dedicated To You（4★）
meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Hey, Toya. There's something I want to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: This wedding video's been going viral on social media, and I saw two guys that looked exactly like you and Akito in it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's us.
Someone passing by must've taken that video.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: You serious?! This is what you guys do for work?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing like that.
I was there because a friend of mine couldn't make it that day.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, okay... But this was pretty surprising, you know? I mean, look, your dance moves are perfect!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: When we're playing soccer during gym and stuff, you hardly ever do anything so I just assumed you weren't that athletic or something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, it's not quite like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand the rules, but really don't know what I should be doing. I end up hesitating a lot because of that...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: You don't know what to do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. For tennis or volleyball, you just need to send the ball back to your opponent's half of the court.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But for soccer or basketball, positioning is much more important and how you strategize is completely different, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll spend most of my time just trying to think of what to do next, but the match is always over before I realize it.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Hahaha! That's pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: At the same time, that means you really pay close attention to your surroundings and what other people are doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: So if you can learn about more of the theoretical stuff, I can ask you to help us out too, with Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you and Akito went to junior high together, right? Have you been asking him to help with the soccer club since then?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah. Where I'm from, he used to be pretty famous!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: He quit playing right after we started junior high and wouldn't talk to me for a while but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey. What are you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Hey, it's Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's me. That reminds me, you brought back my textbook, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Here you go. Thanks a bunch!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyways, what were you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The surprise show we did for that wedding we went to. Apparently, people have been posting videos of it online.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: And I was saying how surprised I was by Toya's dancing and was wondering if I could ask him to help with the soccer club too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He was sort of all over the place at first, but got better fast when he started to get the hang of everything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think he even looked the best because of that metronome inside his head.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah, see what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But soccer seems like an entirely different story. Also, I work in the library so I really doubt that I have the time to help...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Dang...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: But you like being active and moving around, right? You might not do a whole lot in gym and stuff, but you usually look like you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Having fun, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Up until high school, I almost always sat on the bench and just watched. I never thought that I could have fun doing anything athletic like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you may be right. I think I am having fun...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: You think? Dude, it's your life!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Okay, how about this? Let's go somewhere together and have some fun!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
You know, that one arcade?
The one with all the sports stuff!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You really like that place, huh?
Didn't you go there right before you took the entrance exam for this school?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: It has the power to cheer anyone up. I mean, you go to that one cafe all the time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's different. I'm not there to play around.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
Alright, alright.
So what do you say, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Not really your thing...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's not that.
You're sure about inviting me along?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Of course. The first time we ever talked was during the School Festival, and I thought you were pretty cool so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just accept it...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: What he said.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's go next weekend or something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've probably never been anywhere like this, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I haven't.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When is the last time I went anywhere with anyone from school...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hadn't thought about it since forming BAD DOGS after I met Akito...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As students, you get to experience so many different things, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It all contributes to the ways you express yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (MEIKO did say that...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, mind if I invite some other people too? It'd be fun to have enough for a game of futsal!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, why not?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And thank you for inviting me.
I'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah! This is gonna be awesome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Haha! You're like a little kid!
